# Indowud

> > Indowud manufactures eco-friendly waterproof and termite-proof NFC (Natural Fiber Composite) and WPC boards for sustainable construction and interior design.

Indowud specializes in wood-alternative building materials including NFC Jaali perforated screens, WPC plywood boards, and waterproof decking solutions. Their products use sustainable materials like natural fibers and polymers, offering termite resistance and moisture protection for residential and commercial applications.

- NFC (Natural Fiber Composite)
- WPC Plywood Boards
